channel.title: TransformerPath — Daily Intel
channel.description: Daily transformer industry news, market intelligence, tenders and grid updates.

item.title: Power grid modernization accelerates transformer demand
item.description: Global utilities investing in grid transformation — new transformer orders surge 23% YoY as utilities modernize aging infrastructure and integrate renewable energy sources.

item.title: Copper prices hit 13-year high, transformer costs climb
item.description: Copper trading at $13,500/tonne amid supply constraints and EV demand. Transformer manufacturers absorb costs or pass to buyers — delivery times extend to 18+ months.

item.title: HVDC interconnector orders boost power transformer segment
item.description: Five new HVDC projects announced in ASEAN region — 15+ power transformers on order, lead times now 24 months as converters and special types strain production capacity.
